title: Count up
description:
Read a whole number `n` and print the numbers from 1 to `n`, each on its own line. For `3`:

```
1
2
3
```

If `n` is zero or negative, print nothing.
hints: A counting loop has three parts: where to start, when to keep going, how to step: `for (int i{ 1 }; i <= n; ++i)`.
